blockers.name: Multi-repository implementation scope exceeds single-pass change window
blockers.why_needed: Requested deliverable requires simultaneous implementation across primary and secondary repositories plus design-reference benchmarking before coding
blockers.exact_fix: Stage the work into approved milestones with explicit per-repo ownership, then execute in sequential PRs (foundation APIs -> state/contracts -> page shell -> feature depth -> QA hardening).

blockers.name: Missing integration credentials and OAuth app configuration
blockers.why_needed: Apps hub, provider health, browser/video/graph/course backends, and approval execution require live credentials and callback URLs for secure end-to-end wiring
blockers.exact_fix: Provide environment variables and secrets for GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, Google, Slack, Discord, Twilio, YouTube, Figma, OpenRouter, NVIDIA, plus redirect/callback domains for Vercel environments.

blockers.name: Undefined production contracts for required new APIs
blockers.why_needed: Frontend architecture depends on stable response schemas for /api/agent/status, /api/skills, /api/models, /api/workflows, /api/apps, browser/video/graph/course/approval endpoints
blockers.exact_fix: Publish OpenAPI/JSON schemas and acceptance criteria for each route, including health semantics, error taxonomy, and approval state transitions.

blockers.name: No validated benchmark assets from reference products
blockers.why_needed: Prompt mandates HyperAgent/Manus/Apple-level interaction quality; this requires explicit UX copy/system/interaction audits and component acceptance standards
blockers.exact_fix: Create a product benchmark package (flows, IA, motion standards, accessibility/perf budgets, mobile breakpoints) signed off before implementation sprint.
